sectors.name: Technology
themes: US hyperscaler AI spending is a durable demand driver for Indonesian semiconductor and component suppliers, amplifying local tech valuations on any global capex beat.
Domestic digital-infrastructure upgrades—data centers, 5G, and cloud adoption—create a structural revenue base for Indonesian hardware and networking firms independent of US rate cycles.

Currency and liquidity dynamics favor selective tech exposure: IDR stability plus foreign inflows into Jakarta-listed tech names amplify upside when global risk appetite is normal, but demand strict v
sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesian tech names on US AI capex spillover, but stay nimble: 2454 and DIVA lead local momentum with double-digit gains, while global semis (MPWR, ANET, COHR) confirm the cycle. Rotate into hardware/connectivity plays tied to data-center buildout; avoid laggards lacking earnings catalysts. Take profits on 9988 spikes; re-enter on dips toward support.

sectors.name: Financials
themes: US alternative asset managers benefit from secular growth in private credit and infrastructure, driving sticky fee-related earnings regardless of rate cycles.
Specialty insurers (ERIE, LPGI) are capitalizing on hard-market premium rates and disciplined underwriting, sustaining margin expansion into 2025.
Indonesian financials remain pressured by weak loan growth and high funding costs, but digital banking adoption and infrastructure financing offer long-term structural upside.
sectors.ai: Rotate into US alternative asset managers (ARES, APO) and specialty insurers (ERIE, LPGI) on durable fee-related earnings and hard-market pricing; trim Indonesian laggards (TIFA, TRIM) as domestic liquidity stays thin. Favor US over ID for near-term alpha, but keep ID exposure for long-term structural growth.

sectors.name: Mining & Energy
themes: Indonesia's downstream nickel smelting capacity expansion, backed by export bans and HPAL investments, structurally re-rates integrated producers like NCKL and HRUM regardless of global price swings.
Domestic coal demand from new smelters and power plants creates a local pricing floor, insulating ID-listed miners from US thermal coal weakness and supporting stable margins.
Government push for energy security and EV battery supply chains accelerates M&A and capex in copper-gold and nickel assets, favoring AMMN and FPNI as long-term compounders.
sectors.ai: Buy pullbacks in nickel and coal names with domestic offtake (NCKL, HRUM, AMMN) as ID outperformance persists despite US softness; ALKA/BAJA spikes are low-float noise, not fundamentals. Rotate into downstream smelting and energy-transition metals, avoiding US-exposed thermal coal.

Hold AEE/LNT for defensive utility cash flows. Watch ARRY for a breakout above resistance; add on confirmation, not before.

sectors.name: Infrastructure

State-owned gas and toll-road operators (RGAS, IKAI) benefit from structural energy-transition and connectivity spending, insulated from external rate shocks.
Logistics and materials names (TALF, TKIM) are re-rating on domestic demand recovery and export-linked capex, offering asymmetric upside as rupiah stabilizes.
sectors.ai: Buy infrastructure selectively: JKON's +34.85% confirms construction re-rating on IKN spillover, while RGAS/IKAI gains signal gas-distribution and toll-road momentum. Rotate into TALF (logistics) and TKIM (pulp/paper capex) for follow-through. Avoid chasing APEX/ETN one-day spikes; hold core positions in SOFA for stable cash flows. Target names with direct government contract visibility ahead of Q3 budget execution.

sectors.name: Healthcare
themes: Indonesia's universal health coverage expansion is driving durable volume growth for private hospital operators like SILO, PRIM, and MIKA, as out-of-pocket spending rises with the middle class.
US continuous glucose monitoring adoption is accelerating, with DXCM's double-digit move reflecting durable demand from diabetes prevalence and reimbursement tailwinds.
Surgical robotics penetration in Southeast Asia is at an inflection point, with ISRG's growth signaling long-term hospital capex cycles that benefit distributors and service providers.
sectors.ai: Healthcare is flat but selective; buy SILO, PRIM, and MIKA on Indonesia's outpatient and private-hospital demand, and add DXCM for US CGM momentum. Avoid JECX and SRAJ despite gains—liquidity is thin. Rotate into ISRG for structural robotics growth. Maintain neutral sector weight, overweight domestic operators.

sectors.name: Logistics
themes: Indonesia's e-commerce parcel volume growth is structurally compounding, driving sustained re-rating for last-mile operators like MITI and TRUK beyond current spikes.
Cold-chain logistics is a durable growth pocket as food and pharma distribution modernizes, benefiting PSSI and SAIA on rising regulatory standards.
Port and airport infrastructure monetization is a multi-year theme, with KPIG and PURA positioned to capture tariff and land-lease upside independent of macro cycles.
sectors.ai: Buy the pullback in MITI and TRUK on confirmed volume; both are re-rating on e-commerce parcel demand and last-mile consolidation. Trim TAXI exposure — the +7% is a one-off airport-route renegotiation, not structural. Overall sector signal NORMAL means add selectively, not broad beta. Watch PSSI for cold-chain spillover if MITI holds gains into next week.

sectors.name: Entertainment, Media & Consumer Services
themes: Indonesia's rising middle class and urbanization continue to drive discretionary spending on entertainment, media, and consumer services, underpinning sustained revenue growth for domestic players.
Digital advertising and content monetization are accelerating as mobile-first consumption deepens, benefiting platforms with strong user engagement and data-driven ad targeting.
Out-of-home media is gaining share as brands shift budgets toward high-impact, measurable DOOH formats, supported by improving digital infrastructure and urban footfall recovery.
sectors.ai: Buy TMPO, KDTN, and MAPI on momentum; their sharp gains signal strong domestic consumption and digital ad demand. Trim VIVA and GOOG exposure as upside looks priced in. Rotate into FUTR and DOOH for structural out-of-home and content growth. Maintain WATCH, adding on pullbacks.

Layer-1 and interoperability tokens (ATOM, DOT, POL) are consolidating as structural infrastructure plays, offering lower volatility than speculative DeFi names.
